content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Alignment for AI-Driven Drug Discovery Initiatives
agenda_items: Review of current AI model performance in early-stage compound screening
Discussion on data governance protocols for multi-institutional research collaborations
key_decisions: Establish a working group to develop a standardized data sharing framework for collaborations, with a focus on privacy-preserving techniques.
Allocate dedicated computational resources for exploratory research into quantum machine learning applications for protein folding prediction.
attendees: Dr. Kenji Tanaka (Head of Data Science)
Prof. Mei Ling (External Advisor, Machine Learning)
